front.title: MICA-NEX v0.3: Authenticated Measurement Ingestion for Model-Agnostic Nano-Instrument Agent Swarms

abstract.t: This document describes a narrow, testable next step in the MICA-NEX proposal: cryptographically binding nanoscale instrument measurement claims to externally provisioned acquisition and calibration signer roles while denying model planners the ability to self-certify measurement status. The reference implementation uses Ed25519 signatures, SHA-256 content binding, typed units, time windows, source-kind separation, and a persistent local replay ledger. In a hardware-disconnected test harness, 60/60 signed synthetic test records from three simulated instrument classes were admitted and 30/30 adversarial cases were rejected for the expected reason; 28/28 Python tests passed. No instrument, laboratory calibration, external reviewer, clinical context or independent physical replication was involved. Signature validity is deliberately distinguished from scientific validity.
